title: FinishInfo
$comment: Role: why generation stopped (docs/architecture.md §2; ocai/core/finish.py FinishInfo) in omit-absent wire form. Two-lane honesty: `reason` is the canonical OPEN stop code and `native` preserves the provider's verbatim wire value — an unknown wire value decodes to reason "unknown" with the native lane intact, never a raise (total decode, rule 6). `detail` is a tagged union with its own open registry (DETAIL_REGISTRY): known tags dispatch to a variant subschema via if/then; a tag this revision does not know matches no branch and still validates (that payload decodes to DetailOpaque, byte-faithful). Boundary rule (normative): a mid-generation refusal or filter stop is a RESPONSE carrying this info; a pre-generation block is a ContentFilterError — no response existed to report on.
description: Why generation stopped: the canonical open stop code, the provider's verbatim native value, and an optional typed elaboration.

reason.description: The canonical open stop code. Known canonical values: complete, max_tokens, stop_sequence, tool_call, content_filter, refusal, recitation, paused, malformed, error, unknown. An OPEN vocabulary, never a closed enum: a wire value core does not recognize decodes to "unknown" with `native` preserving it verbatim.

native.description: The provider's verbatim wire value (e.g. "length", "end_turn", "RECITATION"), always preserved — the second lane of the two-lane honesty pattern.

detail.description: The typed elaboration, when the reason warrants one (safety ratings, refusal categories, truncation notes, mid-generation errors).

finishDetail.$comment: The FinishDetail tagged union (ocai/core/finish.py), kept open through DETAIL_REGISTRY: known canonical tags dispatch to a variant subschema via if/then; unknown tags are LEGAL and decode to DetailOpaque, which preserves the payload verbatim. DetailOpaque doubles as the deliberate opaque member — finish details are terminal metadata, never re-encoded into requests, so the opaque/unknown split parts use is collapsed here.

type.description: The open detail discriminator. Known canonical tags: safety, refusal, incomplete, error (plus the placeholder `undefined`). Unknown tags are LEGAL: readers decode them to DetailOpaque, preserving the payload verbatim.

safetyRating.$comment: ocai/core/finish.py SafetyRating — one per-category safety assessment inside a safety detail. Not an IR envelope carrier: a plain value object like span.

level.description: The open severity/probability code, provider-verbatim (e.g. "HIGH"); absent when the provider gives none.

blocked.description: Whether this category triggered the block, when the provider says so.

ratings.description: The per-category assessments the provider reported.

block_source.description: The open code for which safety layer blocked (e.g. "provider", "platform"), when distinguishable.

detailRefusal.description: Elaboration for refusal stops — reason "refusal", pairing with a refusal part (RefusalDetail).

category.description: The open refusal-category code, provider-verbatim, when given.

explanation.description: The provider's human-readable explanation, when given.

detailIncomplete.description: Elaboration for truncated/paused stops — reasons "max_tokens" and "paused" (IncompleteDetail).

note.description: The provider's explanation of what was cut short or how to resume, when given.

detailError.description: Elaboration for error stops — reason "error" (ErrorDetail). A finish record on a response that partially exists; a call that produced nothing raises through the error taxonomy instead.

code.description: The canonical error-taxonomy code, when mappable (e.g. "transient").
